text: Relay Process Monitor Capability（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 Agent 编写的 Relay 监控 Bundle 提供进程状态能力。插件向 DSH 注册进程能力，并为 Agent 提供签发进程句柄的工具；句柄绑定当前会话和项目目录，监控端可查询对应进程是运行中还是已退出。适合需要在 Relay 任务中查看项目相关进程状态的用户。需要安装 Relay Monitor Core 和 Author 插件，以及 Node.js 22.13 或更高版本。

Relay Process Monitor Capability (DSH web plugin) adds process status to Relay bundles. An Agent issues a handle bound to its session and project, then queries whether the process is running or exited. Install with Relay Monitor Core and Author; requires Node.js 22.13+.
想让 Relay 监控显示某个项目进程还在不在运行。
能不能给当前会话里的进程做状态查询？
I need a Relay monitor to tell whether a project process is still running.
Relay Process Monitor Capability 的功能「签发进程句柄」：Agent 提交 PID，工具返回供监控使用、绑定当前会话和项目的句柄。
Relay Process Monitor Capability 的功能「查询状态」：监控端提交句柄，可获得进程身份、运行状态和退出码是否可用的信息。

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-process README · Relay Process Monitor Capability：This extension supplies a read-only, identity-safe process status capability for
Agent-authored Relay Monitor Bundles. It deliberately does not add a prebuilt Bundle
Type: the Agent discovers no process type, issues an authorized Process Handle, and
uses the `relay-monitor-author` Skill to create a task-scoped Bundle.

Install the exact public release together with Monitor Core and Author:

relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-process README · Relay Process Monitor Capability：```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-rc.1 plugin --profile web add --save-exact \
  relay-dsh-plugin-monitors@0.3.2-rc.1 \
  relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-process@0.1.3-rc.1 \
  relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author@0.1.3-rc.1

The same artifacts retain compatibility with audited DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` profiles.

The plugin issues opaque, Session- and project-bound Process Handles. A PID is
accepted only at handle issuance and is never embedded in a custom Bundle.
